summary: Lookout site in Greenlee County, AZ, filed under Apache-Sitgreaves NF and marked gone; no build, staffing or site-condition details in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.org's Arizona list marks it gone; no source describes the site today

evidence.supports: Gobbler Point listed in Greenlee County, type unknown, status gone
Arizona index files Gobbler Point under the Apache-Sitgreaves National Forest

notes_for_editor: Story is about 60 words, below the 120-word floor, because the only usable evidence is two list rows; not padded. Coordinates conflict: data/sources/peaks_gnis.json (local GNIS cache, not a fetched page) lists a Gobbler Point in AZ at 33.83666, -109.17109, about 35 km from the record's 33.63733, -109.46214. Not verified and not changed. A search returned a hiker trip report (hikearizona.com photoset ID 64005) that reportedly says a wooden lookout may have stood here in the 1930s and that nothing remains; the fetch returned HTTP 403, so it is not cited. A search snippet mentioned a lookout inventory marking it Former with a wood type; I could not read that page, so it is not used. Forest Lookouts page westlookouts.weebly.com/gobbler-point.html returned 404.
